question: What is declared to be the clear body of the power of action?
premises: The mutual variety of the powers is the supreme expression of kriya-shakti.
This occurs in the fourteenth abode where the three powers are manifest.
inference: The manifest interplay of the three powers is the clear body of kriya-shakti.
uncertainties: The identity of the fourteenth abode is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: They declare this very mutual variety to be the supreme, clear body of the power of action, in this fourteenth abode where the three powers have become manifest.
